summary: deliver webhook sink blocks loopback/private/link-local/unspecified targets at dial time (covers redirects + DNS rebinding); IGNITION_DELIVER_ALLOW_PRIVATE=true opts out for local dev.
reason: Greptile PR #1528 P1 security: the webhook sink accepted any http/https URL and followed redirects with no destination restriction, so a caller reaching --deliver could hit cloud metadata (169.254.169.254) or internal services (SSRF). The guard is a net.Dialer.Control hook so it re-checks every resolved IP on every hop, not just the parsed URL.
validated_outcome: Manual: --deliver webhook:http://127.0.0.1:9/x is rejected 'private or internal address'; with IGNITION_DELIVER_ALLOW_PRIVATE=true the same target dials (connection refused = dial attempted). Public targets unaffected.
